name: Grape Manifest
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Milly Osworth's recovered harvest is bound for the stores after brigands seized it.

sections.title: A Record of the Harvest
sections.body: Northshire Abbey depends on nearby farms for its food and drink. The lost harvest put its stores in danger. Now the crates are reclaimed, and the quartermasters can balance supplies and ready barrels for fermentation. Milly Osworth's manifest records the quantity they need to plan.

sections.title: The Abbey's Cellarer
sections.body: Brother Neals oversees Northshire Abbey's food and drink. He enjoys sampling its wine in the quiet of the bell tower. Knowing the grapes are coming helps keep the monks and visiting recruits supplied with drink. Each saved bushel strengthens the abbey's stores and brings a blessing from the Holy Light.

faq.answer: Milly Osworth's Grape Manifest records the harvest recovered from her overrun vineyard. It tracks the fresh grapes bound for Northshire Abbey.

aliases: who do i give grape manifest to
faq.answer: Brother Neals receives Milly Osworth's manifest. He oversees the abbey's food and wine stores and often samples vintages in Northshire Abbey's bell tower.

faq.q: Why were the grapes in danger?
faq.answer: Defias brigands drove Milly Osworth from her vineyard in Northshire Valley. The harvest was at risk, and the abbey lost its fresh fruit until recruits intervened.

faq.q: What does Brother Neals do with the grapes?
faq.answer: Brother Neals uses the grapes to replenish the abbey's food stores and ferment fresh Northshire wine. The wine supplies the resident brotherhood and visiting defenders.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see how field harvests supply the abbey's stores and help feed its monastic community.
As a human, you see the early struggles of Stormwind's heartland. Even monastic life and simple harvests need armed defense against roaming outlaws.
